name: Spike
description: Spike is an AI-powered conversational email client and workspace that layers unified inbox, groups, channels, notes, tasks, calendars, meetings, and collaboration over users' email accounts.
agentUseSummary: Spike cannot currently be connected because its official public surface documents a client layered over underlying Gmail, Microsoft, iCloud, Yahoo, Exchange, and IMAP accounts, not a third-party Spike data API. No Spike-native app registration, delegated OAuth, scopes, token lifecycle, webhooks, or external schemas are published, and Relay will not relabel an email provider or the separate iGPT service as Spike.

blocked.label: Connect a Spike account
blocked.description: Spike does not publish a current third-party API and delegated authorization contract for accessing a user's Spike-native data.

blocked.label: Alias an email provider as Spike
blocked.description: Gmail, Microsoft, iCloud, Yahoo, Exchange, IMAP, SMTP, and CalDAV authority belongs to those underlying providers and must not be represented as Spike access.

blocked.label: Alias iGPT as Spike
blocked.description: The newly advertised iGPT email-intelligence developer API is a separately branded service with its own API key, ingestion, billing, and data-source contracts, not a Spike account API.

blocked.label: Access Spike data
blocked.description: Accounts, unified inboxes, messages, threads, groups, channels, notes, tasks, teamspaces, calendars, meetings, contacts, attachments, AI features, and every read or write are unavailable.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent action can be enabled without an official Spike-native provider API and delegated authorization contract.

runtimeSupport.description: Spike has no public provider contract that Relay can mount as OpenClaw tools.
Spike has no public provider contract that Relay can mount as Hermes tools.

providerSetup.blocker: Spike documents a client of underlying email providers but no public Spike-native API, delegated app registration, scopes, tokens, revocation, webhooks, or stable external schemas; iGPT is a separate product.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not request email or Spike credentials and do not show Connect. Reconsider only if Spike publishes or supplies a written multi-tenant Spike-native API and delegated authorization contract; treat iGPT as a separately named candidate if desired.

evidence.supports: Spike documents signing in with an existing email address and operating over Gmail, Microsoft 365/Outlook/Exchange, iCloud, Yahoo, and IMAP accounts.
Spike's official help defines client-side product concepts such as messages, threads, priority inbox, groups, notes, and tasks but no external API schemas or authorization lifecycle.
Spike describes its own access to connected email-provider data; that does not authorize Relay to access Spike as a third-party provider.
Spike's help banner links to a separately branded iGPT developer API with its own API-key and email-ingestion product, not a Spike account API.
